dedupe_keys.name: plastic film extrusion process and defect records

description: The Kaggle contributor podsyp publishes process data for a three-layer plastic-film extrusion line. Three plants heat and draw granular material into film, while sensors monitor product properties and operators identify defects. The card describes holes, unmelted granules, scale and film breakage; its manifest lists process CSV data, a statistics CSV and an XLSX legend. Location, observation dates and sampling intervals are not stated. Access is free under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 within its noncommercial and no-derivatives restrictions. A limitation is that defect timing can be reconstructed from film length and marker positions, not observed in real time, introducing uncertain alignment with sensor readings. Simulation uses include testing process-quality associations and breakdown warning inputs after checking the legend. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with production-line quality events. No traces were downloaded and causal explanations of defects were not verified.
